statements.t: In addition, we may not achieve the expected benefits of our reorganized business segment structure.

Research & Development Solutions’ contracted backlog increased from $34.0 billion (recast amount to reflect segment changes noted above) as of December 31, 2025 to $34.2 billion as of June 30, 2026, and we expect approximately $9.2 billion of this backlog to convert to revenues in the next twelve months.
We have and expect to transfer cash from those subsidiaries to the United States and to other international subsidiaries when it is cost effective to do so.
We cannot provide assurances that we will be able to complete any such financing arrangements or other transactions on favorable terms or at all.
